about: The Remnant of Nawlins brings New Orleans cooking to 1416 Groesbeck St in Bryan.
Destination Bryan tells its story as a legend reborn in the wake of Hurricane Katrina, and lists it among Bryan's Black-owned restaurants.
It's open Monday through Saturday, 11 a.m. to 8 p.m., with 4.6 stars across 908 Google reviews.
